sokkel-tui.note: Not in sokkel-tui's reports as of b99664f.

summary: How much of something there is on a known scale, as a bar: a disk filled, a quota used, a battery left. With bounds the bar takes a tone: good, warning or critical.

anatomy.container: A row wrapping, 12 apart across and 6 down: the label and the value on the first line, the track under them across the whole width.
anatomy.label: At text.sm 500.
anatomy.value: At the line's end at text.sm in muted-foreground, tabular; in warning-ink in the warning tone, at 500 in critical-ink when critical. Without a format, the share as a whole percent.
anatomy.indicator: The track filled from its start to the value over the scale, rounded full: primary without bounds, else good, warning or critical.

low.does: Where the scale stops being good.

optimum.does: Which end is good: low, so a fuller bar reads worse, or high.

format.does: Writes the value; a whole percent of the scale by default.

rest.means: No bounds: the bar in primary.

good.means: Within the good end: the bar in good.
good.reached: up to low (with optimum high, from high up)

warning.means: Between the bounds: the bar in warning, the value in warning-ink.

critical.means: Past the bad bound: the bar in critical, the value in critical-ink.
critical.reached: past high (with optimum high, under low)

drift.today: As of b99664f its reports name no such part.
